name: Configure SEB Client Connection
description: Create a new SEB Client Connection Configuration in the SEB Server web interface for campus-wide deployment. Navigate to 'Connection Configuration' under 'Configurations' in the left sidebar, then click 'Add Connection Configuration' in the right-side action panel. Create a new connection configuration with the following settings: Name it 'Campus Lockdown Browser Config'. Set the Configuration Password to 'ExamQuit2024' (and confirm it). Check the 'With Fallback' checkbox, then set the fallback start URL to 'https://exam.university.edu/login'. After saving the configuration, click 'Activate Connection Configuration' in the right-side action panel to ensure it is active. The SEB Server is accessible at http://localhost:8080 with login credentials super-admin / admin.
